summary: Retest of the iteration_23 follow-up items. All of them pass. (1) Admin PUT /users/:id {password} for the dispatcher and PUT /drivers/:id {password} for maria both end old sessions: the old access token gets 401 on /auth/me (and on /drivers/my-vehicle for the driver), the old refresh token gets 401 on /auth/refresh, and the old password gets 401. The new password works. A name-only PUT keeps the session. Both passwords were restored. (2) Atomic reset: 5 concurrent POST /auth/reset-password with the same token, 3 rounds each for james (driver) and the dispatcher (user). Every round gave exactly one 200 and four 400s. (3) tokenVersion and passwordHash are absent from /drivers, /drivers/1, /drivers/4, stops-board, odometer-corrections, /trips, /trips/active, /trips/:id, /reports/trips, /vehicles, /users, /auth/me, the driver login response and the driver endpoints, and from the PUT responses. (4) Rate limit: 60 sequential successful driver-logins across 5 accounts all gave 200. So did 60 successful dashboard logins and 60 concurrent driver-logins (20 in parallel). 11 failures on one email: the 11th is 429. After 10 failures, even the correct password gets 429 on that IP+email. 51 failures across emails: the 51st is 429, and interleaving successful logins does not reset the per-IP failure count. (5) XLSX with driver 4 named =HYPERLINK(...): no <f> cells, the text is stored as-is with no leading apostrophe. CSV has the quoted '= cell with inner quotes doubled. Name restored to 'Sarah Johnson'. (6) Driver app login (390x844 web): an empty submit, a wrong password ('Invalid credentials or inactive account') and a 429 ('Too many attempts. Please wait 3 minutes and try again.') all show inline in testID login-error. The correct login reaches Home and stores the tokens. (7) Regression test_round23_security.py: 20/20 pass. New test_round24_followups.py: 13/13 pass. On the first run, one test hit a transient ConnectTimeout to the preview host; it passed on rerun. All 7 test_credentials accounts log in at the end. Michael's trip 6 is still in_progress. auth_rate_limits cleared.

minor.issue: tokenVersion is now bumped (REST and refresh revoked: verified). Live sockets that are already open are not disconnected, unlike the reset flow (authController.ts:234/243). They stay connected until the access-token expiry timer in socket.ts closes them. userController.ts:99-104, driverController.ts:92-99

action_items: LOW: When an admin changes a password via PUT /users/:id or PUT /drivers/:id, also call disconnectUserSockets / io.of('/driver').in(driverRoom(id)).disconnectSockets(true), the same way the reset flow does.

LOW: tokenStorage.ts (native): the legacy migration SecureStore.setItemAsync (line 22) and the deleteItemAsync calls in clear() (line 41) are not wrapped in try/catch. A keystore error there would still throw.
critical_code_review_comments: User/Driver beforeUpdate hooks bump tokenVersion whenever passwordHash changes. This covers both reset and admin edit.
resetPassword claims the token with a conditional UPDATE (usedAt null) before changing the password. Verified race-safe.
rateLimit.ts takes the hit back on res 'finish' only for status < 400, so only failures add up. The 429 responses themselves also count as hits, which is acceptable.
